# EnterpriseGlue v0.29.1 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.29.0`.

## Highlights

- **frontend-host:** Aligns the dashboard time-period filter with the content edge when the current organization has no selectable engine.

## User and administrator impact

- The time-period filter no longer appears stranded to the left of an empty engine-filter slot on new or engine-free organizations.
- When an engine is available, both dashboard filters remain grouped and right-aligned.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Upgrade the frontend image; no backend, configuration, or data changes are required.

## Database migrations

- This frontend-only change does not alter persistence or database behavior.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Documentation

- The versioned technical release notes describe the dashboard empty-state alignment fix.

## Validation evidence

- Focused Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit checks cover engine-free and populated dashboards at desktop, ultrawide, 200% equivalent reflow, and mobile widths.
- Audited and visually inspected 1440x900, ultrawide, reflow, and mobile screenshots of the engine-free and populated layouts.
